opening.argument: The segment presents the free-gift-card message as an object of verification, not as an offer for viewers to pursue. It introduces the subject by explaining, “Our Verify team checks one post that has been popping up online,” then identifies the circulating claim that texting TARGET to 83361 would produce a free gift card. It counters that claim with the company’s warning: “The company says do not click or respond any ads offering free gift cards.” The conclusion is explicit: “we can verify this post definitely false it is a scam.” The phone screen marked FALSE reinforces that the segment is investigating and warning about the message, while its closing context supports that reporting purpose rather than promoting the gift-card claim.
